subject: POC access & success criteria — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: James Liu <james.liu@acme.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC access & success criteria — next steps

Thanks again for the call this afternoon — great conversation. Per our discussion, I wanted to recap proposed success criteria, ownership, and next steps to get your POC started. Please let me know if anything is missing or needs adjusting.

Summary / success criteria (proposed)
- End-to-end integration: Acme engineering can run 1k inference requests/day against Redwood hosted POC with <= 300ms p50 latency for 512-token context.
- Functional validation: 3 core flows validated (search re-rank, support summarization, intent extraction) with accuracy targets prioritized by your team.
- Cost/throughput metrics: baseline per-token cost and throughput targets documented for comparison against production plan.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): Access provisioning (API key, IP allowlist, SSO invites) and test harness access.
- Week 1: Integration sprint — ingest sample dataset, run smoke tests, surface metrics.
- Week 2: Feature validation against 3 flows, gather qualitative feedback.
- Week 3: Review retrospective + decision (expand, optimize, or stop).

Owners
- Redwood: Marissa (POC owner), Dylan (SE / infra support).
- Acme: James (engineering lead), Sarah (product / PM).

Requested access items (what we need from you)
1) Okta org or SAML metadata for SSO invites (preferred) OR list of user emails for direct invites.
2) IP ranges to allowlist for outbound connections from your side (if you maintain egress controls).
3) A short sample dataset (anonymized) or pointers to dev endpoints for testing.

Attachments
- I've attached a brief POC SOW and a mutual-action-plan workbook for tracking tasks.

Next steps / asks
- James / Sarah: confirm required access method for SSO and the primary engineer to coordinate (name + email).
- Redwood: we'll provision a time-limited API key and send SSO invites as soon as we receive Okta metadata or user emails.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the actual invites and the temporary API key once Dylan provisions them.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: James Liu <james.liu@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: POC access & success criteria — next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. We're aligned on the success criteria. A couple quick clarifications before we proceed:

1) SSO: We use Okta. I'll share SAML metadata with you (IT prefers we send to a single contact). Please confirm who should receive it.
2) IP allowlist: We can allowlist outbound ranges on our firewall. Can you provide the specific egress IPs or CIDR ranges Redwood will use for the hosted POC?
3) API Keys: We'll need the API key and an expiration window. Can you confirm default validity (we prefer 30 days and the ability to revoke).
4) Data retention / logs: Do you have SOC2 evidence or a short note on data retention for POC data? Our security team will likely ask.

Primary engineer coordinating integration: Sarah asked me to loop in our lead eng, Elena Gomez (elena.gomez@acme.com) — copying her on the follow-up thread separately.

If you can get the SAML metadata recipient and the IP ranges to us today, we can attempt to get IT to open the allowlists tomorrow.

Thanks,
James
Senior Engineering Manager | Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: James Liu <james.liu@acme.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC access & success criteria — next steps

Thanks James — great questions. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

1) SSO recipient: please send SAML metadata or Okta org admin contact to marissa.cole@redwood.ai. Dylan (cc'd) will create the SSO invite once we have the metadata.

2) IP allowlist: For the hosted POC we operate a small set of egress IPs. For this POC we've allocated the following CIDR ranges to your testing pool: 34.203.120.0/24, 54.208.45.0/24. If your firewall needs concrete hosts we can provide a short-lived hostname list as well.

3) API keys: We'll generate a time-limited API key valid for 30 days by default and you can request extension. Keys are revocable on demand. Dylan will include the temporary key and usage notes in his next email.

4) Data retention / SOC2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant — I'll attach the SOC2 summary and a short note on POC data retention: POC logs and data are retained for 30 days by default unless you request otherwise; we can configure shorter retention for test datasets. For a formal report, I can route your request to our security team.

Attachments: I attached the POC SOW and mutual action plan (see links above).

Next steps (action owners)
- Acme: share SAML metadata or list of user emails for SSO (James).
- Acme: add IP ranges above to allowlist (IT) or confirm a different range (James / Elena).
- Redwood: Dylan to provision API key + SSO invite and post back details.
- Everyone: quick sync on Thursday for integration status (15-20 min).

I'll keep the Thursday invite tentative until we have the API key provisioned.

Best,
Marissa

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: James Liu <james.liu@acme.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC access & success criteria — next steps

Hi James / Sarah — quick operational update: we've provisioned the POC tenant and completed the following.

- API key: A time-limited key has been created with 30-day expiry. Key (placeholder, please do not paste into chat): rwd_pk_test_************. We'll deliver the full key via secure link (DocuSign / one-time view) — please confirm preferred delivery method.
- IP allowlist: We confirmed the POC egress CIDRs (34.203.120.0/24, 54.208.45.0/24). If your firewall needs specific IPs, tell us and we will provide the list.
- SSO invites: I sent an Okta SAML invite to the admin contact (per the metadata Marissa received). If you don't see it, check spam or ask your Okta admin to accept the app integration.
- Test endpoints & docs: Hosted test endpoint (internal): https://poc-api.redwood.ai/acme — I'll share the Postman collection and quickstart snippet after you confirm delivery method for the key.

Security note: For the POC we've set default retention to 14 days for logs and 30 days for datasets; if you need that reduced to 7 days, let us know and we'll adjust on provisioning.

Next steps (operational)
1) James / Elena: confirm preferred key delivery method (secure link or SAML-backed ephemeral token).
2) Acme IT: confirm allowlist applied and report any blocking traffic.
3) Marissa / Redwood: schedule Thu sync if you want to demo integration progress — otherwise we'll send the Postman collection once key delivery is confirmed.

Happy to jump on a quick call to walk Elena through the integration.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
